mapping.rule: trust = clamp(defaultTrust + (importance - 3) * 0.1, 0, 1), rounded to 1e-6; no importance at the Provider: defaultTrust
mapping.score: search and related scores are relevance only; trust orders equal scores and gates recall through minTrust (compared with a 1e-9 tolerance)
mapping.readBack: Insight.importance is the stored 1..5 importance; facts written before the fix have none and report none
mapping.existingFacts: left unchanged: trust 1.0, no importance field
mapping.gate: search, browse (list), graph, the Entities page (built from list) and related reads leave out facts below minTrust; a minTrust above defaultTrust + 0.2 hides every new fact, while older facts at trust 1.0 stay visible
mapping.receipts: a stored fact below minTrust keeps action stored and adds hiddenByMinTrust, trustScore, minTrust and a hint; a duplicate of a hidden fact is skipped with a summary saying it is hidden; Status counts every stored fact

otherProviders.mnemon-native: passes the 1..5 importance to the CLI (--imp)
otherProviders.retaindb: sends importance: request.importance ?? 0.7. The Source always sends 1..5, so the 0.7 default never applies; the default suggests a 0..1 API scale. Not verified against a RetainDB server; reported, not changed here

rollback.data: every fact is kept; an earlier driver ignores the importance field
rollback.scores: an earlier driver multiplies new facts by their trust: a 0.9 phrase match becomes 0.63, 0.54, 0.45, 0.36, 0.27 for importance 5..1; an importance-1 entity match at 0.8 becomes 0.24 and is dropped under the 0.25 floor

knownEffects.entitiesOrder: the Source orders an entity's memories by importance ?? 0, so older facts without importance sort last in a mixed store; cosmetic, the Source is not changed
